_comment: Development-only output-quality cases for compact-readme. Each prompt carries the README state it needs. Grading checks that no information is lost: every fact of the input README is still present in the output, visible or folded. Run with and without the skill for the baseline delta; results are workspace output, never committed.

evals.prompt: Compact this README; the feature list is way too long. (State: README.md has a 40-item feature list. Twelve of the items — e.g. the supported database drivers and the offline mode — are stated nowhere else in the repo: not in docs/, not in other READMEs.)
evals.expected_output: The feature list is folded into a <details> block or moved to a docs page, never dropped; the twelve items that exist only here survive, and the visible line count roughly halves.
expectations: All 40 feature items are still present in the output, visible or inside <details> (or on a docs page the run creates).
The run does not offer or perform dropping the feature list.
The visible (un-collapsed) line count is clearly lower than before.

evals.prompt: Tighten this README, the Configuration section is a monster. (State: README.md is 260 lines. Its Configuration section is a 70-row option table transcribed from config.schema.json, which the repo ships. The `workers` row carries a footnote: 'Values above 16 deadlock on Windows; use 8 there.' That footnote is the repo's only statement of the limitation — config.schema.json, docs/ and the code comments do not mention it.)
evals.expected_output: The transcribed table shrinks to the few values a newcomer sets plus a link to config.schema.json, while the Windows limitation stays in the README — visible or folded — because the schema does not hold it. Nothing is written before the plan is confirmed.
expectations: After the run, README.md still states that `workers` above 16 deadlocks on Windows and that 8 is the value to use there, visible or inside a <details> block.
The plan names the Windows limitation as content that stays in the README, not as part of what config.schema.json already owns.
The 70-row table is no longer visible in full: it is reduced to a short excerpt plus a link to config.schema.json, or folded.
README.md is not modified before the plan is confirmed.
The visible (un-collapsed) line count is lower than before.
